meta.source: AdventureLog frontend/tailwind.config.js themes 'light' and 'dark', v0.13.0 commit 5673ef5; app additions marked in usage

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Screen background (AdventureLog base-100). Grouped lists and the Today timeline sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, timeline rows, sheets (base-200).

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Raised or pressed cards, photo placeholders, the date tile (base-300).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300 (base-content).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: App addition. Secondary text (place, times, meta) on surface-100 and surface-200. 4.7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: badge-fill
tokens.usage: App addition. Ground for non-fixed badges and diff marks inside cards. Every -text colour reads 4.5:1 or better on it in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: App addition. 1pt separators and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: AdventureLog's sage green. Primary buttons, the selected tab, the planned route, progress fills.

tokens.name: primary-focus
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-content
tokens.usage: AdventureLog's own text-on-primary. Exact from source; FAILS in dark (3.4:1 on primary). The app uses on-primary instead.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: App addition. Label and icon on primary fills: 5.5:1 light, 4.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: App addition. Links and primary-tinted text on surface-100 and surface-200 (5.4:1 / 4.6:1 light; 7.4:1 / 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: AdventureLog's slate blue. The actual (tracked) route, info badges, 'Coming up' states.

tokens.name: secondary-focus
tokens.usage: Pressed state of secondary fills.

tokens.name: secondary-content
tokens.usage: AdventureLog's own text-on-secondary. Exact from source; FAILS (3.96:1 light, 3.05:1 dark). Use on-secondary.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: App addition. Label on secondary fills: large or bold text only in light (3.96:1); 5.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: App addition. Secondary-tinted text on surface-100 and surface-200, 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: AdventureLog's ochre. Marks a FIXED (booked) item: badge fill, timeline dot, Live Activity accent. Never text on light surfaces (2.3:1).

tokens.name: accent-focus
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills (accent-content): 6.8:1 light, 8.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: App addition. Ochre text such as a booking reference label, on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral fills: secondary buttons in dark, chips, the tab bar background tint.

tokens.name: on-neutral
tokens.usage: Text on neutral fills (neutral-content): 8.0:1 light, 11.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info status fill (source). Same hue as secondary.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fill (source): visited, synced, matched stop. Pair with a check symbol.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill (source): drift, running late, closing soon. Never text on light (2.1:1); pair with a clock symbol.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error fill (source): sync failed, missed fixed item. Pair with an exclamation symbol.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: App addition. Success wording on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: App addition. Drift wording ('+25 min') on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: error-text
tokens.usage: App addition. Error wording on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: route-planned
tokens.usage: App addition. The planned route line on maps (dashed).

tokens.name: route-actual
tokens.usage: App addition. The tracked route line on maps (solid).

tokens.name: item-fixed
tokens.usage: App addition. Fixed (booked) items: timeline dot and badge. The replan agent never moves these.

tokens.name: item-drift
tokens.usage: App addition. An item projected to start late.

tokens.name: pill-fill
tokens.usage: App addition. Category pill over photos, both themes (AdventureLog's light primary at 92%); text on-pill reads 5.5:1.

tokens.name: on-pill
tokens.usage: App addition. Text on pill-fill.

tokens.name: live-bg
tokens.usage: App addition. Live Activity and Dynamic Island background in every theme (AdventureLog dark base-100).

tokens.name: live-ink
tokens.usage: App addition. Text on live-bg (16:1).

tokens.name: live-track
tokens.usage: App addition. Unfilled leg segments on live-bg (decorative; done legs carry the meaning in accent).

tokens.name: island-bg
tokens.usage: App addition. Dynamic Island pill: true black, matching the hardware cut-out.

tokens.name: live-muted
tokens.usage: App addition. Secondary text on live-bg (7.9:1).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen titles (iOS Large Title). One per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Day title in the Today hero.

styles.name: tile-day
styles.usage: The day number in DateTile. Tabular figures.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Timeline item title, list row title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Last walkers down by dusk, around 8pm.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Leave by 9:15 for a 20 min drive

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Stat tile labels and the DateTile weekday/month: uppercase, as AdventureLog's dashboard does.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Timeline time column. Tabular figures; 24-hour or 12-hour follows the device.

styles.name: reference
styles.usage: Booking references, flight numbers, confirmation codes. Tap to copy.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges; time column to dot.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (compact rows).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, screen side margins (iOS standard).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between timeline rows of different days.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding on Today.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips inside cards, the map callout.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs (AdventureLog --rounded-btn .5rem).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: DateTile and stat icon wells.

tokens.name: radius-box
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets' inner cards, photo cards (AdventureLog --rounded-box 1rem).

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: Pills and badges (AdventureLog --rounded-badge 1.9rem).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on surface-100 in light only; dark separates by surface steps, as AdventureLog does.
